scope: Kubernetes incident guardrails; enterprise qualification required per platform

egress_profile.objective: Constrain new workload connections while preserving approved dependencies.
egress_profile.coverage: Checks the Pod egress-profile label on CREATE/UPDATE.
limits: A label check does not enforce connectivity.
Changing network policy can affect existing connections differently across CNIs.
dependencies: CNI enforces namespace and workload NetworkPolicies
Approved DNS, database and observability paths are documented
platform_evidence: Allowed and denied connection probes on the target CNI
Availability floor and evidence collection remain healthy
egress_profile.rollback: Restore the approved network and admission revision; rerun connectivity and availability probes.

deny_privilege_escalation.objective: Reject newly created privileged containers and containers permitting privilege escalation.
deny_privilege_escalation.coverage: Regular and init containers on Pod CREATE; privileged=false and explicit allowPrivilegeEscalation=false.
limits: Does not evict existing Pods.
Does not implement the full Restricted Pod Security Standard, runAsNonRoot, capabilities, seccomp or ephemeral-container controls.
dependencies: Admission-controller availability and failure policy reviewed
platform_evidence: Positive and negative CREATE requests on the target API server
Existing-workload response and debug-subresource restrictions reviewed
deny_privilege_escalation.rollback: Move this control to Audit or restore its previous revision; assess each workload before replacement.

restrict_registry.objective: Limit image sources for newly created or changed regular containers.
restrict_registry.coverage: Registry prefix on regular-container images on Pod CREATE and image-changing UPDATE.
limits: Registry allowlisting does not verify signatures or provenance.
Init and ephemeral container images are not covered by this template.
Mutable tags and existing image compromise need separate controls.
dependencies: Registry reachability, authentication and mirror availability
platform_evidence: Init/ephemeral coverage, digest pinning and signature verification disposition
restrict_registry.rollback: Restore the approved registry list or previous policy revision after reviewing image provenance.

restrict_api_access.objective: Reduce the compromised identity's effective Kubernetes API permissions.
restrict_api_access.coverage: Review-only requirement; this compiler does not render RBAC changes.
limits: Token automount settings do not revoke already exposed credentials.
Admission does not observe get/list/watch operations.
platform_evidence: Positive and negative authorization tests for the actual principal
restrict_api_access.rollback: Restore only reviewed minimum permissions and verify intended reads and denied writes.

deny_sa_token_for_agent_sidecars.objective: Disable automatic Kubernetes token mounting in Pods marked as containing an agent sidecar.
deny_sa_token_for_agent_sidecars.coverage: Marked Pod CREATE requests must set automountServiceAccountToken=false.
limits: Explicitly projected token volumes are not prohibited.
A sidecar shares the Pod identity and may access other mounted credentials.
Unmarked Pods and existing Pods are not covered.
dependencies: Independent agent identity where isolation is required
platform_evidence: Existing workload replacement and availability checks
deny_sa_token_for_agent_sidecars.rollback: Review identity dependencies before restoring token mounting; rotate exposed credentials.

deny_agent_mutation_outside_namespace.objective: Backstop agent writes to supported workloads outside its home namespace.
deny_agent_mutation_outside_namespace.coverage: Named requester on deployment/statefulset/daemonset CREATE/UPDATE plus supported scale subresources.
limits: Does not restrict reads, DELETE, arbitrary resource types or impersonated principals.
Requires standing RBAC reduction and protected policy-engine permissions.
dependencies: Authenticated principal bound to the agent
Policy and exception writers cannot be controlled by the agent
platform_evidence: Agent denial and human access checks including scale subresources
deny_agent_mutation_outside_namespace.rollback: Restore reviewed principal scope and policy revision; verify cross-namespace writes remain denied by RBAC.

require_ticket_on_agent_changes.objective: Require a change reference on supported agent workload mutations.
require_ticket_on_agent_changes.coverage: Nonempty annotation on supported CREATE/UPDATE requests by the named agent; Deny stage remains Warn in this compiler.
limits: A nonempty ticket string does not prove valid approval or approval scope.
Scale subresources and other resources need separate coverage.
dependencies: Authoritative approval lookup bound to principal, request and expiry
platform_evidence: Missing, forged, expired and scope-mismatched approval tests
Ticket service failure and authorization handling
require_ticket_on_agent_changes.rollback: Return to Audit while preserving change audit records and independent approval requirements.

audit_replica_surge.objective: Observe deployments and scale updates exceeding an approved replica threshold.
audit_replica_surge.coverage: Deployment CREATE/UPDATE and deployment/scale; this compiler has no namespace filter on this control.
limits: This is a capacity signal, not proof of compromise.
The current template can match deployments cluster-wide; review scope before use.
Autoscaling and incident load require operational context.
platform_evidence: Namespace scope and HPA availability review
audit_replica_surge.rollback: Restore the previous threshold and Audit action after service-owner review.

process.objective: Govern staged rollout, evidence preservation and bounded exceptions.
process.coverage: Human disposition; no admission policy is generated for this decision.
limits: Owner and TTL metadata do not prove expiry enforcement.
Quarantine levels require observable triggers and rollback criteria.
platform_evidence: Exception expires and access is denied after expiry
process.rollback: Follow incident commander criteria; record restored controls and remaining risks.

not_implementable.objective: Route requirements beyond this admission compiler to their actual enforcement owner.
not_implementable.coverage: Explicit unsupported requirement; no policy or security success is inferred.
limits: Reads, tool calls, evidence capture and existing processes require other enforcement layers.
dependencies: Named requirement owner and enforcement component
platform_evidence: Requirement-specific positive and negative runtime or application test
not_implementable.rollback: Restore the reviewed enforcement component according to its own playbook.
